output.subject: We have received your complaint about the paper statement fee
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us on your grandparent's behalf, and please pass on our thanks to them as well. We have received the complaint, and we want you both to know that a person has read it carefully.

Here is what you told us. Your grandparent has held their savings account with us for many years, since before the bank was called Meridian Harbor. This month a $2.00 charge described as PAPER STMT FEE appeared on the account. They say nobody told them about a fee for their statement. You mentioned that they do not use a computer and do not want to receive statements that way. You asked us to remove the charge and not to charge it again.

A specialist team is now reviewing the complaint, and we will respond within 10 business days. We're sorry for the worry and frustration this has caused.

Thank you again for taking the time to write to us.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: The account holder is ⟦NAME_1⟧. ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧ is the granddaughter who typed the letter. Confirm who the reply should be addressed to and adjust the greeting if needed.
Check whether the granddaughter is authorised to receive account information before sharing any specifics with her.
The account holder does not use a computer. Consider sending the reply, and any future response, by post.
Check whether and when the account holder was notified of the paper statement fee.
Decide on the request to refund the $2.00 fee.
Decide on the request to stop future paper statement fees, including any exemption that may apply to customers who cannot use electronic statements.
The account holder is 93 years old. Consider whether vulnerable-customer handling applies.
